meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,你描述一个 bug 或报错,Claude 会查代码并试着让问题重现,判断该归 LazyCodex 还是上游 Codex,再在对应仓库查重;最后生成一份 GitHub 问题单(issue),包含重现步骤、根因和修复建议(只有上游仓库且你要求时才做成代码修改请求 PR),并打上专用标签。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分类某个 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发;这类诉求常伴随查根因、写复现步骤和明确提交到哪个仓库。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 在什么情况下崩溃?该报给哪个仓库?
say.note: 它会定位归属,并说明原因和下一步。

say.text: 我在 openai/codex 的分支上修好了此 bug,请帮我准备 PR。
say.note: 它会核对分支与验证结果,按规则创建并打标签。

howto.what_en: Claude investigates code, reproduces the bug, decides which repo owns it (LazyCodex vs upstream Codex), de-dupes, files an issue containing root cause, repro, and fix; only upstream Codex can get a PR if you ask. Adds a label.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, often with requests for a root cause, repro steps, or target repo.

say_en.text: Turn this LazyCodex bug into an issue: investigate cause and pick the repo.
say_en.note: Claude gathers evidence, de-dupes, and writes the issue.

say_en.text: Where does this Codex CLI crash, and which repo should I report it to?
say_en.note: It identifies the owner repo and explains next steps.

say_en.text: I fixed this bug on an openai/codex branch; please prepare a PR.
say_en.note: Checks the branch and files a labeled PR for openai/codex.
